title: The Broken Crescent
working_title: History Before Time: The Broken Crescent
logline: The cradle-of-civilisation wonders the package tour will never sell — Ur, Babylon, Bamiyan, Palmyra, the sites behind checkpoints and headlines — and a man who has walked worse roads goes in anyway, not to conquer them but to witness what remains before the next war takes the rest.
blueprint: Jakobus-led wonder-of-place — the unvisitables belt (Iraq · Afghanistan · Syria · adjacent); grounded not woo; witness-not-saviour; local custodians out-read him; the tourism the world can't have
market: literary travel-adventure — forbidden archaeology with documentary honesty and the dignity firewall
